content.title: Fix double-at regex deviation in mentions extractor
content.description:
The mentions extraction regex in src core mentions.ts currently uses a lookbehind class that treats the at-sign as a non-word boundary, so double-at tokens like @@alice incorrectly match the second at-sign and extract alice. Per the spec, the lookbehind class should EXCLUDE the at-sign character so that @@name does not produce a mention.

Scope:
- Update the regex in extractMentions so the lookbehind uses a negated character class that excludes both word chars AND the at-sign (equivalent to: start of string, OR preceded by a char that is neither a word char nor an at-sign).
- Un-skip the two currently-skipped deviation tests in tests core mentions.test.ts named 'double @@ should NOT match' and 'double @@ in middle of text should NOT match'. They should pass as-is once the regex is fixed.
- Add one or two extra edge cases if helpful (for example @alice@@bob, or triple @@@alice) to lock the behavior.

Risk: low. One-line regex change. Verify the full mentions and tracker-mentions suites still pass.
